sources.title: Hyundai Canada - Frequently Asked Questions (NACS and Supercharger access)
sources.notes: Read directly: IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 9 from the 2026 model year have a NACS port; other EVs with a CCS port, 'such as the 2026 KONA Electric', and Hyundai EVs of model year 2025 and earlier, can use a NACS adapter 'available separately'. Hyundai Canada EV hub (https://www.hyundaicanada.com/en/evhub/electric-vehicles) adds a free CCS-to-NACS adapter offer for native-CCS Hyundai EVs until 2026-12-31 or while supplies last (Bluelink enrolment and EV Special Care service; eligible models not listed there).

sources.title: Kia US - 2026 Niro EV
sources.notes: Read directly: 'Access more than 30,000 NACS compatible Tesla Superchargers w/ a NACS adapter (sold separately)'; 64.8 kWh battery. Does not name the port type.

sources.title: Kia Canada - Kia EV Charging Guide: NACS, CCS & Authorized Adapters
sources.notes: Page body not readable by the fetcher; wording taken from a search excerpt: factory NACS ports on 2025+ EV6, 2026 EV9 and 2027 EV5; earlier Kia EVs with CCS1 ports, including Niro EV, need a Kia-approved NACS adapter. Corroborated by the Kia Canada press release of 2025-04-28 (relayed at https://finanzen.net/nachricht/aktien/kia-canada-s-electric-vehicles-adopt-north-american-charging-standard-nacs-14428477, 403 to fetcher, search excerpt only): first NACS Kias are the 2025 EV6 and 2026 EV9; EV6, EV9, Niro EV and current Soul EV owners can buy an accessory adapter at Kia dealers in Canada.

charge_port.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ names the 2026 KONA Electric as an EV with a CCS port that can use a NACS adapter available separately.

supercharger_access.notes: Per the same FAQ, with a NACS adapter (sold separately; Hyundai Canada EV hub also advertises a free CCS-to-NACS adapter offer until 2026-12-31 for eligible native-CCS EVs, model list not shown).

charge_port.notes: Kia Canada guide (search excerpt): factory NACS only on 2025+ EV6, 2026 EV9, 2027 EV5; CCS1 Kia EVs including Niro EV need an adapter. Kia US 2026 Niro EV page also says Supercharger access needs a NACS adapter. Niro EV not on any factory-NACS list; no page states 'CCS1' for the 2026 Canadian Niro EV outright. Port inferred: the Kia Canada release (2025-04-28, search excerpt) lists only the 2025+ EV6 and 2026 EV9 as factory-NACS and offers Niro EV owners an adapter.

supercharger_access.notes: US page: Supercharger access 'w/ a NACS adapter (sold separately)'. Kia Canada (2025-04-28 release, excerpt) says a Kia accessory adapter is sold at all Canadian Kia dealers for Niro EV owners; Tesla app required in Canada.
